events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21st.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Mad for it? Liam Gallagher is another year older, another year rock 'n' roll. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo anthem 'Imagine' was released on October 1st, 1975, changing the musical landscape.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... celebrating this timeless track! John Lennon's 'Imagine' dropped 51 years ago today. Still gives you chills, right?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on October 3rd, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years since the original iPod changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred, it's James Bond Day! Which Bond theme song gets your vote as the best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday on October 9th.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message still resonate deeply.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon and Monty Python legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27th.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: No silly walks, just big laughs! Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese. What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on November 22nd, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of pure genius! The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped today in '68. Which track is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, on November 24th, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true icon. The incomparable Freddie Mercury's legacy lives on forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3rd, 1965, marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A truly influential album. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music legend John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a voice that inspired millions. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless impact.
